_comment: Card packs are the only way to receive new cards. Each slot rolls a rarity from the pack's weights; 'min' raises that slot to at least the given rarity. Duplicates become upgrade copies; copies of a card already at max level turn into 'overflow_coins' per copy (Update 9). Pity (Update 9): after 'pity.epic' - 1 packs in a row without an Epic or better the next pack's last slot is at least Epic, and after 'pity.legendary' - 1 packs without a Legendary it is Legendary. 'pity.counts' names the pack types that advance each counter: every pack for the Epic guarantee, Pro and Champion Packs for the Legendary one (Rookie Packs are the cheap volume pack); pulling the rarity from any pack resets its counter, and signature packs never touch them. Counters persist in the profile (Profile.pity_left). Update 9 also lowered the natural Legendary weights (0.1 / 0.4 / 1.2 to 0.03 / 0.2 / 0.6) so the guarantee carries most Legendaries: tools/balance/economy.py puts the whole collection at about 27 hours and the first Legendary at about 3 hours.
